name: Second Quarter
brief: District in Jerusalem mentioned by Huldah and Zephaniah
short: The Second Quarter was a district in Jerusalem mentioned in connection with the prophetess Huldah (<ref="2Ki. 22:14; 2Chr. 34:22">2Ki. 22:14; 2Chr. 34:22</ref>) and in Zephaniah's prophecy (<ref="Zeph. 1:10">Zeph. 1:10</ref>).
